blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `cancelDraftOrderEditWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow cancels a draft order edit. It's used by the
[Cancel Draft Order Edit Admin API Route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#draft-orders\_deletedraftordersidedit).

You can use this workflow within your customizations or your own custom workflows, allowing you to wrap custom logic around
cancelling a draft order edit.

If you use this workflow in another, you must acquire a lock before running it and release the lock after. Learn more in the [Locking Operations in Workflows](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/locks#locks-in-nested-workflows) guide.
